title: ClearDAO
tagline: A data DAO to manage urban governance and transparency issues in mexican cities
description:
This project manages DAO proposals for public places minted as NFTs on the FEVM and rewards content storage with an ERC20 token.

ClearDAO looks to bring transparency to the urban governance process and match Mexican citizens' commitment with the DAO's collective benefits.
how_its_made:
This project was built on a nextjs app, we ported the smart contracts from Ciudades DAO into the Filecoin Wallaby Testnet: the governor alpha contract to manage urban governance proposals in Mexico and a governance token for rewards on governance and storage interactions. 

ClearDAO is set to store digital files generated on the National Transparency Platform from Mexico.
